title: LLM-Generated Negative News Headlines Dataset: Creation and Benchmarking Against Real Journalism

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Part-of-Speech (POS) distributions, perplexity, readability scores, and semantic similarities between LLM-generated text and human-written journalism to identify structural generation patterns and artifacts, such as a statistically significant lack of proper nouns.

Evaluating the model's natural inclination towards certain news topics by prompting it to generate headlines without specifying or restraining the category, then observing and analyzing the resulting distribution of news segments.

Applying tailored prompts to intentionally induce a negative valence bias (avoiding targeting specific demographic groups), and validating the outputs using sentiment analysis tools to ensure the generated text consistently reflects the intended negative sentiment compared to real-world news.
